title: The Godfather
about: A mafia patriarch hands the family business to his reluctant youngest son.
cue: Pour the Chianti when the wedding band starts up in the opening scene.
faces: The pushcart market round our corner, where we buy every tomato.
Salami, aged provolone, olives and roasted peppers, at room temperature.
Crisp risotto balls, fried golden round a melting mozzarella heart.
Pork and beef meatballs, fennel sausage, slow tomato, pecorino.
We cook with Genco Pura olive oil. Prices subject to change. OLinville 2-1972. Form L-46.
Thin cutlets pan-fried in butter, with Marsala wine and mushrooms.
Pounded to order. Allow a few minutes.
Antipasto, rigatoni and gravy, the veal, cannoli, espresso.
Sunday in the garden: fruit, red wine, family.
Crisp shells, orange-scented ricotta, dark chocolate, crushed pistachio.
Boxed and tied with string, for the ride home.
Slow tomato, sausage and meatballs, all Sunday morning.
Dark roast, a curl of lemon peel.
By the glass, from the straw bottle.

Divide the cold risotto into 8 portions and wrap each around a cube, rolling into balls.Roll the balls in flour, dip in the beaten egg and coat in breadcrumbs.Chill the crumbed balls for 20 minutes so they hold their shape.Heat the oil to 170°C and fry in batches until golden and hot through, about 4 to 5 minutes.
